question: Apple's Products gross margin dollars increased in FY2025 ($112,887M vs $109,633M in FY2024) but Products gross margin percentage decreased (36.8% vs 37.2%). What explains this?
answer: Products gross margin rose to $112,887 million in FY2025 from $109,633 million in FY2024, while the margin percentage fell to 36.8% from 37.2% [2]. The dollar increase was driven by favorable costs and a different mix of products, partially offset by tariff costs [1]. The percentage decline was primarily due to the product mix shift and tariff costs, partially offset by other favorable costs [1].
